item.title: American trivia night to be held in Sequim - Peninsula Daily News
item.description: SEQUIM — The New Dungeness Chapter of the National Society of the Daughters of the American Revolution and George Washington Speaks will host “America250 Trivia Night: A Historic Benefit for the New Dungeness Lighthouse” at 6:30 p.m. Saturday.

item.title: Saltfire Theatre to stage ‘Much Ado About Nothing’ - Peninsula Daily News
item.description: PORT TOWNSEND — Saltfire Theatre will stage “Much Ado About Nothing” with shows at 7 p.m. Fridays and Saturdays and matinees at 1 p.m. Sundays through April 12.

item.title: Story Slam program set for Friday at Sequim theater - Peninsula Daily News
item.description: SEQUIM — Nessa Goldman will host Out Loud Story Slam: Grand Slam at 7 p.m. Friday at Olympic Theatre Arts, 414 N. Sequim Ave.

item.title: Pianist to perform during Candlelight Concert series - Peninsula Daily News
item.description: PORT TOWNSEND — Kevin Ayesh will present “A Musical Springtime Bouquet” at 7 p.m. Thursday during the Candlelight Concerts series.

item.title: Hearing examiner rejects resort request - Peninsula Daily News
item.description: Development may move forward with conditions

item.title: Port Angeles commission sends Laurel Street stairs project to subcommittee - Peninsula Daily News
item.description: PORT ANGELES — The Port Angeles Parks, Recreation and Facilities Commission has deferred making a recommendation to the city council regarding the Laurel Street stairs project.

item.title: Red Dog is gearing up for summer season - Peninsula Daily News
item.description: Starts are planted, seasonal workers hired at Chimacum farm

item.title: ‘Back to Basics’ acting workshop set next month - Peninsula Daily News
item.description: PORT ANGELES — Paul Kiernan will present an acting workshop, “Back to Basics,” beginning at 3:30 p.m. April 11.

item.title: Tickets on sale for four-day Olympic BirdFest - Peninsula Daily News
item.description: SEQUIM — Tickets are on sale for Olympic BirdFest 2026.

item.description: PORT ANGELES — Gail Archer will perform “A Concert for Peace: An all-Ukrainian Organ Concert” at 3 p.m. Sunday.
